name: IONIZERS
text:
Infrared sauna is a place for relaxation and improving your well-being. Ionizer is one of the devices that you can have in your infrared sauna to help you.

Ionizer works by purifying air within the sauna. As you sweat and breath this increases humidity in the sauna which in consequence creates an environment for harmful microorganisms to thrive. It is important to wash yourself up after the sauna and humidifier does the same for the sauna. Infrared sauna ionizers remove pollutants, allergens, odors and create an environment where harmful microorganisms such as bacteria cannot survive.

Ionizers can improve breathing as a result, besides providing other health benefits.

If you’re looking for a replacement because if your ionizer has stopped working or there is an issue with it - we can help you by either repairing it or providing a replacement for it. If there is a problem with your ionizer, use the troubleshooting form.

We’re looking forward to resolving your issues to help you enjoy sauna more.
text_short: It is strongly recommended the use of ionizer to rid the air of pollution. Ionizer is a device which purifies the air inside an infrared sauna. During an infrared sauna session, a human body releases toxins and bacteria through sweat. Therefore, It is very important to refresh and clean the air after each sauna use, to prevent allergies and lung diseases. Our ionizers remove pollutants, allergens, dust and odor causing bacteria.
